question: Should OpenClaw make 256 MiB the hard cap for ClawHub package, skill, resolver, GitHub-source, and ClawPack archive downloads now?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and matches the marketplace archive cap, but the product compatibility choice is whether any legitimate ClawHub artifact above 256 MiB should keep installing.

options.title: Accept the 256 MiB cap
options.body: Merge this hard cap and treat larger ClawHub artifacts as unsupported unless a concrete need for a different policy appears.

options.title: Request a different cap policy
options.body: Ask for a higher limit or registry/manifest-backed policy before merge if maintainers expect valid ClawHub artifacts above 256 MiB.

options.title: Pause for inventory proof
options.body: Hold the PR until someone checks current ClawHub package sizes and confirms no important published artifact exceeds the cap.

recommendation.title: Accept the 256 MiB cap
recommendation.body: Merge this hard cap and treat larger ClawHub artifacts as unsupported unless a concrete need for a different policy appears.
